title: Exam Leak Link
scenario: A message claims leaked exam papers are available if you pay a small crypto fee.

answers.A: Ask a trusted adult or school staff through a known channel.
answers.B: Click the link or follow the instruction quickly so you do not miss out.
answers.C: Report/block it and do not share private details.
answers.D: Ask the sender in the same chat to prove it is real.

explanation: Exam Leak Link: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to ask a trusted adult or school staff, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Leaked-paper offers are unsafe and can also get you in trouble.
